data.name: 刹车踏板 深踩时
data.title:
车速为0时深踩刹车踏板才生效(有车速深踩无效，即使深踩后车速到0也无效)

注：焕新Y/YL只有TSL8/9才支持此事件(需升级至V4.1.30或以上)，TSL6不支持。

免责声明：如果您是联动执行换档操作，请一定要确认车辆档位后方可松开刹车踏板。使用此功能造成的一切后果由使用者承担，添加保存即表示接受此声明。
data.title_en:
Works only when you press the brake pedal hard at speed 0 (a hard press while moving does not work, even if the speed then drops to 0)

Note: on Model Y refresh/YL, only TSL8/9 supports this event (update to V4.1.30 or later). TSL6 does not support it.

Disclaimer: if you link this event to a gear shift, always check the gear before you release the brake pedal. The user is responsible for all results of this function. When you add and save it, you accept this disclaimer.

注：焕新Y/YL只有TSL8/9才支持此事件(需升级至V4.1.30或以上)，TSL6不支持。
data.title_en:
